doc.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021

chapter: Sun Ra's last years and the estate
title: Sun Ra's community and money
summary: Asked about the Arkestra's living arrangements, Gordon says he guesses cash dealings run through Danny Thompson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I only have two more questions Monk, and then once we finish the recording I have a couple of quick things I want to ask before we go. But my one last question, we touched on it a little bit but I study intentional communities and there’s no doubt that Sun Ra had an intentional community. Did you ever have any sense more about the living arrangements there? I mean did he receive all of the salaries and dole out the money? How did the grocery shopping work? Buying clothes? Any ideas about these things?

Not really but he trusted Danny Thompson a lot and I figure they operated a lot on a cash basis and when they had money, you know Sun Ra gave money to the appropriate party. That’s how I figure it went.
But I don’t know more than that. You know. I don’t know if he took out for Social Security or not. I don’t know how their money worked.
He was on — he had his own thing going on, Sun Ra, interplanetary harmony.
